# Triggers of the Western Crossing.
zin_west_is_western = {
	has_country_flag = zin_region_west_lands
}
zin_west_historical = {
	OR = {
		has_game_rule = { rule = zin_rule_west_route option = historical }
		AND = {
			has_game_rule = { rule = zin_rule_west_route option = DEFAULT }
			zin_rules_is_historical = yes
		}
	}
}
zin_west_in_crossing = {
	OR = {
		has_country_flag = zin_west_pledged
		var:global.zin_west_convener = {
			tag = PREV
		}
	}
}
zin_west_is_leader = {
	has_variable = global.zin_west_convener
	var:global.zin_west_convener = {
		tag = PREV
	}
}
zin_west_council_can_meet = {
	NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_west_grey_ford_war }
	OR = {
		has_global_flag = zin_eindil_war_king
		has_global_flag = zin_west_truce_permanent
		date > 1751.3.1
	}
}
zin_west_question_open = {
	has_global_flag = zin_west_council
	check_variable = { global.zin_west_unity > 39 }
}
zin_west_crossing_ready = {
	has_global_flag = zin_west_route_crossing
	check_variable = { global.zin_west_pledged_count > 2 }
	check_variable = { global.zin_west_fleet > 49 }
	check_variable = { global.zin_west_resolve > 59 }
	OR = {
		has_global_flag = zin_war_of_last_crowns
		AND = {
			date > 1754.3.1
			check_variable = { global.zin_west_resolve > 79 }
			any_country = {
				zin_aenor_is_realm = yes
				OR = {
					has_civil_war = yes
					has_war = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	OR = {
		AND = {
